description: List the tables in a base, with fields and views at the requested level of detail.

baseId.description: ID of the Airtable base whose tables to list.

detailLevel.description: Level of detail for the returned tables: tableIdentifiersOnly (table ID and name only), identifiersOnly (IDs and names for tables, fields, and views), or full (the complete schema, the default).

name: list_tables
